remarks: Enjoy this beautiful New-York-style, sun-drenched two bedroom condo in the heart of downtown with heat and hot water included! This luxury building offers concierge services, a 24-hour fitness facility, and spacious club room. As you enter the unit you are greeted with gorgeous 10 ft ceilings and beautiful hardwood floors. A chef's kitchen awaits with modern finishes including custom white cabinets, granite countertops, white subway tile, and Wolf professional appliances. A wonderful living and dining room area with expansive windows provides for open-concept living. The primary bedroom offers a large walk-in closet with professional storage systems as well as a fully updated en-suite bathroom. A generously-sized second bedroom as well as full hall bath with jacuzzi tub completes the space. One reserved parking spot is included in the rent. Guest parking is available with this building. All of these features and just minutes away from the train, restaurants, shops, and parks!
